purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review for Saki, Oyo State, Nigeria.
assessment: Oyo State's official OyoGISS/OSGSIS and Office of the Surveyor General services establish a local land and spatial-information custodian relevant to Saki. The public OYSG PGP route did not expose an anonymous feature response, and the Digital Land Survey Plan Registry is a lookup service requiring an exact survey-plan name or number. No parcel polygon or safe native parcel identity was retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre custodian verified: Oyo State Government land administration through the Ministry of Lands, Housing & Urban Development, OyoGISS, and the Office of the Surveyor General. Official Oyo material separately names Saki in state planning/land-management context.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official OyoGISS page describes a state GIS platform for land administration, urban planning, and spatial data, and says its OYPRS property digitisation covers all 33 LGAs. This is service-scope evidence, not proof of open parcel geometry.
Official OSGSIS landing page links to OYSG PGP, Digital Survey Plan Registry, and Spatial Data Infrastructure products.

Official Digital Land Survey Plan Registry page says the Office of the Surveyor General preserves and verifies survey plans by exact plan name or survey-plan number; it explains that approved basic survey information may be displayed while sensitive/internal records remain protected.
Official Oyo State planning page explicitly mentions redesigning residential plots on stateland along Koomi Road, Saki, Saki West Local Government.
Official Oyo State revenue schedule names Saki-East and Saki-West land-use-charge areas, supporting local administrative scope but not parcel geometry.

searchQueries.result: Found official OyoGISS, OSGSIS, and Digital Land Survey Plan Registry sources. No anonymous safe-ID parcel geometry response was verified.

searchQueries.result: No separate Yoruba-first-party endpoint was found. The official Oyo State English-language land/spatial services were the relevant local results; no anonymous geometry response was verified.

attempts.result: Official landing page reviewed. It exposed links to OYSG PGP at maps-server.oysglands.com, OYSG DSPR, and OYSG SDI; no parcel schema or feature endpoint was present in the page.
Anonymous GET returned an empty HTTP 200 response with a Refresh header to https://oyogsis.oysglands.com. No JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, or feature response was obtained.
Official registry page reviewed. The public search requires an exact survey-plan name or number; no citywide or coordinate-based parcel query was attempted, and no unsafe fields were requested.
The survey-registry link's anonymous GET returned HTTP 403. No retry with credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or TLS weakening was attempted.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not performed against a public feature service; a zero hit, HTTP 403, redirect, or unusable public UI is not treated as citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: OyoGISS describes state-wide land/spatial administration and says OYPRS property digitisation covers all 33 LGAs; the Digital Land Survey Plan Registry is an Oyo State survey-plan verification service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local custodian and service existence verified, but anonymous parcel geometry, native ID schema, CRS, and citywide completeness were not verified.

remainingUncertainty: The public OYSG PGP endpoint structure, access controls, parcel schema/CRS, safe identity fields, and exact WUP-point coverage remain unknown without a separately published anonymous feature service or authorized access.
runtimeAssessment: held; no adapter admission or source integration implied
